tagline: 美能达胶片单反相机，1997 年发布
description: 美能达于1997年推出的胶片单反相机。快门速度30 sec down to 1/1000 sec。使用APS film cartridges, film speeds 25 to 6400 ASA (available films had 100 to 800 ASA)。TTL phase detecting auto-focus with CCD image sensor, switchable to manual focusing by pushing a button on the lens tube。

specs.胶片/画幅: APS film cartridges, film speeds 25 to 6400 ASA (available films had 100 to 800 ASA)
specs.对焦: TTL phase detecting auto-focus with CCD image sensor, switchable to manual focusing by pushing a button on the lens tube
specs.闪光灯: guide number 17 at film speed ISO 200, also used as auto-focus support light
specs.英文简介: The Minolta Vectis S-100 was the lightest and smallest APS interchangeable lens auto-focus SLR camera for Minolta's V-mount lenses (and a with an adapter could mount popular Minolta Alpha/Dynax/Maxxum-mount lenses), with a splash-proof body, and Advanced Photo System film cartridges.
